title: DECSET 1045 — Reverse wraparound mode
summary: CSI ? 1045 h enables reverse wraparound: when the cursor moves left past column 1, it wraps to the previous line. CSI ? 1045 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

gotchas: Reverse wraparound allows the cursor to move from column 1 to the end of the previous line.
Used by some editors for line joining.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1045 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1045 h/l sequences.
